description_en: Queries the log analysis storage capacity of Security Center
description_zh: 查询云安全中心日志分析存储容量
name: DescribeLogstoreStorage

parameters.help_en:
The language type of the request and response messages. Default value: zh. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型，默认为zh。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the request source. Set this parameter to sas
parameters.help_zh: 请求来源标识，固定取值为sas
parameters.name: from

Logstore.description_en: The name of the dedicated Logstore in which full logs of Security Center are stored. The value is fixed as sas-log
Logstore.description_zh: 云安全中心全量日志存放的专属Logstore名称。取值固定为sas-log

Preserve.description_en: The purchased log analysis storage capacity. Unit: GB
Preserve.description_zh: 已开通的日志分析存储容量，单位为GB

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for each request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Ttl.description_en:
The number of days for which logs are retained. The value is fixed as 180, which indicates that logs can be retained for 180 days.
Security Center does not support adjusting the log retention period
Ttl.description_zh:
日志保存天数。取值固定为180，表示日志可保存180天。
云安全中心暂不支持调整日志保存天数

Used.description_en: The used log analysis storage capacity. Unit: GB
Used.description_zh: 已使用的日志分析存储容量，单位为GB

UserProject.description_en: The name of the dedicated Project in which full logs of Security Center are stored
UserProject.description_zh: 云安全中心全量日志存放的专属Project名称
